title: T29 comparison: same-card comparisons, precision controls, capacities and attributed literature

roots.input/: the run folder (submitted manuscript, read only)

cell_convention:
of every row is a dict:
  {"v": value, "src": "<file>#/<json pointer>"}            read from a JSON record
  {"v": value, "src": "<file>:<line>#<column>"}             read from a CSV row (line 1 = header)
  {"v": value, "formula": "...", "from": [src, ...]}        derived here from cited cells
  {"v": null, "missing": "<reason>"}                       not measured / not available
  {"v": value, "basis": "<code or plan location>"}          a label fixed by code or by a frozen plan

blocks.A_sparse: cuSPARSE CSR/BSR applications and refreshes against matrix-free applications (E2, E4)
blocks.B_hou_historical: the seven submitted Hou rows (E10), both codes in one process; application ratios against the ORIGINAL stencil
blocks.C_hou_matched: T27: Hou's released code and our original/repaired paths in separate guarded processes on Hou's system
blocks.D_traeff_fixed_state: T28: Traeff et al.'s released OpenMP-offload code and our paths on its cantilever at fixed states S1 and S5
blocks.E_precision_controls: E8 single-precision controls (original stencil), E29 controls (65.5M element kernels; slender beam: all 13 controls at each of the five grids, own and common V-cycle, and the rounded-coefficient diagnostic)
blocks.F_recursive_control: E12 recursive-stop control (FP32 PCG, FP64 iterate) in complete optimizations, per problem
blocks.G_optimizations: E7/E32/E12/E12b complete optimizations and memory probes (design-iteration denominators, memory definitions)
blocks.H_paired_timings: E32 application survey at 65.5M and the paired fine-level operator swaps

rows.workload: one operator application on a fixed modulus field (operator survey)
rows.system: authors' cantilever grid 64x32x32, unit element matrix, random input vector
rows.code: cuSPARSE CSR SpMV on the assembled matrix

admission.v: built only when 3 x the estimated matrix storage fits the guard's effective free memory

coefficients.v: one modulus field E (log-uniform on [1e-9, 1]) and one input vector for every operator of the record: the assembled matrix is built from E and the matrix-free operators apply E, so each comparison uses identical coefficients

application.statistic: median of 11 randomized timing blocks (IQR in the record)
application.boundary: GPU-event block of repeated applications divided by the count

matrix_free_stencil_same_file.note: original 27-point stencil, same precision, same process

ratio_to_fastest_matrix_free.formula: cusparse_csr median / fastest matrix-free median (same file)

matrix_storage.definition: bytes of the assembled matrix arrays, computed by the driver

setup.boundary: construction of the assembled matrix (pattern and values) between device synchronizations

g4_limitation.v: the activity sampler is a single Get-Counter -Continuous call with a wildcard instance path ('\\GPU Engine(*engtype_3D)\\Utilization Percentage', drivers/t28lib.py:_PS_ACT), which resolves the matching process instances once, at its start. Every activity value and bound covers the process instances enumerated then. The records neither establish coverage of a process created later nor show that such a process interfered (D37)
